answer.rationale: Verify that renewal negotiation delivered material price and payment-term gains and that incumbent continuity avoided disruption. I currently intend to negotiate a cost-reduced renewal with the incumbent: it addresses the spend mandate while protecting a line operating at 94% committed volume with no buffer. A primary-vendor switch is too risky given the low-cost vendor's repeated SLA misses. Uncertainty remains over whether negotiation alone can achieve the full 18% reduction.
